'''Armstiss''' was a location where the [[Poporov merchants]] were situated during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one point the Poporov merchants of Armstiss [[Poporov merchant rebellion|rebelled]] against the Empire, and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strayit]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Marshall Awe]]'' were sent to deal with them. The conflict was ended when Strom took a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt meant for Strayit, and then stuck a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] down the pants of the [[Unidentified Poporov merchant leader|leader]] of the rebels, throwing him off a cliff into his supporters. The resultant explosion destroyed half the merchant stalls in the area, but discouraged any further defiance.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armstiss was first mentioned in the second part of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', an article released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]].
